title: The MLB Wild Card Series starts today with four Game 1s
dek: Baseball's postseason begins today with four best-of-three Wild Card Series, starting with Phillies vs. Braves at 11 a.m. Pacific.
body: October baseball starts a couple of days early this year. The Wild Card Series begins today, and all four matchups play Game 1 this afternoon and evening.

The first pitch is Phillies against the Braves at 2 p.m. Eastern, which is 11 a.m. here on the West Coast, on NBC and Peacock. Later in the day, the White Sox face the Astros, the Red Sox face the Yankees, and the Cubs face the Padres. Each series is best of three, so every game carries a lot of weight.

I love this part of the season because it pulls in people who have not watched a game since spring. Offices put the game on in the break room. Coworkers who never talk sports suddenly want to know the score.
The whole postseason runs through the World Series, which is scheduled for October 23 to 31. That gives everyone about a month of reasons to gather around a screen together.
If your team is playing today, find someone to watch with, even if it is just a group text going back and forth during the late innings.
